facts.text: Nobody told me the mess only serves protein bars. I signed up for a bug hunt, not a diet.
facts.why: Not a Hudson line. His real lines include 'Is this gonna be a stand up fight, sir, or another bughunt?' and 'Game over, man. Game over!' Printed in quote marks and signed Private Hudson.
facts.fix: Is this gonna be a stand up fight, sir, or another bughunt?

vibe.verdict: Great marines mess look and a clever facehugger pudding, but most of the famous lines are left off the table.
missing: Hudson's 'We're on an express elevator to hell, going down!'

The facehuggers in the med lab tanks
